_doc: User-supplied SFX packs → public/sfx/pack/<family>/<slug>.wav. Keys are paths relative to the pack source folder. Run scripts/import_pack.py after adding entries. PACK SOUNDS ALWAYS WIN over the synthesized library.

Essentials SFX Pack/Woosh.WAV.use: Clean, punchy standard whoosh. DEFAULT for slides, pans, zooms and scene-to-scene transitions.

Essentials SFX Pack/Knife Draw.WAV.use: Sharp metallic swipe. Fast text/element slide-in, a 'cutting' reveal, wipe transitions.

Essentials SFX Pack/Grid Trend SFX/Shutt.use: Camera shutter + whoosh. Photo/b-roll grid transitions, photo flying in.

Botanica Trial (10 SFX)/Granular, Transf.use: Granular warp, attack at the start then a tail. Element morphing/transforming, splash-in of a UI card.
Granular warp that swells into its peak. Morph/transform moves, smooth UI transitions.

Botanica Trial (10 SFX)/Spin, Rotation,.use: Card flip, rotation, spinning element or number wheel.

Botanica Trial (10 SFX)/Granular Combo (.use: Long (3 s) granular transition. Into a full-screen animation or a new chapter.

Essentials SFX Pack/Mouse Click.WAV.use: Cursor clicks a button/link in UI. On the press frame.

Botanica Trial (10 SFX)/Granular, Button.use: Soft modern UI tap: toggle, button, chip, tab switch. DEFAULT for UI element pops.

Botanica Trial (10 SFX)/Magnet (2).wav.use: Element snaps into place / locks in (0.3 s). Card landing, logo snapping.

Essentials SFX Pack/iPhone Charging.WAV.use: Phone/iOS UI appears, positive confirmation, something 'connects'.

Essentials SFX Pack/Ding.WAV.use: Success, checkmark, conclusion reached, correct answer.

Essentials SFX Pack/Mac Typing.WAV.use: Typing in a search bar / text field on screen.

Essentials SFX Pack/Gear.WAV.use: Mechanical tick: letter-by-letter text, counter ticking, mechanism.

Botanica Trial (10 SFX)/Glitch, Flicker,.use: Glitchy flicker. Text/number glitching in, tech reveal.
Glitchy flicker (variation). Text/number glitching in, tech reveal.

Botanica Trial (10 SFX)/Shimmer, Particl.use: Sparkle/shimmer. Premium highlight, glow sweep, 'magic' AI moment, big reveal (instead of choir).

Essentials SFX Pack/Heartbeat.WAV.use: Tension, suspense, health/emotion topic. Low level.

Essentials SFX Pack/Grid Trend SFX/Singl.use: One photo pops into a grid.

Essentials SFX Pack/Grid Trend SFX/DSLR.use: Short DSLR click. Photo pop, clip-to-clip flash.

Essentials SFX Pack/Grid Trend SFX/Refle.use: Reflex lens clicks. Photo pop with more body.

Essentials SFX Pack/Grid Trend SFX/Camer.use: Short burst. Several photos popping in fast.

Essentials SFX Pack/Grid Trend SFX/Rapid.use: Rapid-fire shutter (1.3 s). Photo grid filling up.

Essentials SFX Pack/Reverse Crash.WAV.use: 2 s reverse cymbal building into a cut. Peak = end → align 'end' on the transition frame.

Essentials SFX Pack/Metallic Riser.WAV.use: 1.65 s metallic build. Align 'end' on the transition frame.

Essentials SFX Pack/Punch Stop Riser.WAV.use: Short 0.8 s build that stops dead. Hook → body cut, punchline.

Essentials SFX Pack/Cinematic Impact.WAV.use: Big cinematic hit. The ONE loudest moment of the video, under a riser end.

Botanica Trial (10 SFX)/Slowdown, Impact.use: Impact that powers down. Negative turn, 'problem' moment, ending/shutdown.
